subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose Slack and Discord workspace/server channel creation through the message tool and CLI, and what default-off gates, scopes, requester authorization, and gateway permission level should protect that surface?
rationale: The implementation path is source-reproducible, but creating provider-side channels is administrative workspace/server mutation and current main has no accepted Slack admin gate or cross-provider authorization boundary for this capability.

options.title: Approve default-off provider gates
options.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel admin gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

options.title: Narrow to Discord CLI first
options.body: Treat the open Discord CLI PR as the only near-term work and leave Slack channel creation for a later product/security decision.

options.title: Decline native channel creation
options.body: Keep workspace and server provisioning in provider-native admin tools or external scripts unless stronger product demand appears.

recommendation.title: Approve default-off provider gates
recommendation.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel admin gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the detailed prior review and is the clearest routing owner from the discussion plus current CLI/provider history.
